# Spec test-data dependencies

<!-- Generated by bin/spec_deps from the spec code and spec/spec_dependencies.yml. Do not edit by hand; run `bin/spec_deps --write`. -->

Specs share data through `tmp/{YYYY-MM-DD}_data.yml` (`spec/support/data_helpers.rb`).
A spec *depends on* another when it calls `load_test_data(spec_name: 'X')` and a different spec
writes key `X` with `save_test_data`. Some specs also have *state dependencies*, listed in
`spec/spec_dependencies.yml`: an earlier spec writes no new data, but moves an object into the state the later
spec expects (e.g. accessioned, with particular files). Skip it and `load_test_data` still works,
but the later spec times out or fails its assertions.

Run order across types is `registration` → `accessioning` → `sdr` → `verify` → `preassembly` (`spec/spec_helper.rb`), then by file path.
To see or run a spec's prerequisites: `bin/spec_deps prereqs SPEC` / `bin/spec_deps run SPEC`.
To re-run the last run's failures plus their prerequisites: `bin/spec_deps run --failures`.

All paths below are relative to `spec/features/`. Keys containing `*` come from interpolated strings.

## Who writes and reads each data key

| Data key | Written by | Read by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `apo_creation` | registration/01_apo_registration_spec.rb | registration/02_register_objects_spec.rb |
| `constituent_*` | registration/02_register_objects_spec.rb | accessioning/virtual_object_spec.rb |
| `goobi_accessioning` | registration/02_register_objects_spec.rb (`if: $sdr_env == 'stage'`) | — |
| `image_accessioning` | registration/02_register_objects_spec.rb<br>accessioning/image_accessioning_spec.rb | accessioning/image_accessioning_spec.rb<br>verify/image_review_spec.rb |
| `standalone` | sdr/standalone_spec.rb | — |

## Dependencies per spec

"Direct" = data keys the spec loads (including via shared examples) and state dependencies.
"Full prerequisite chain" = every spec that has to run before it, in run order.

### registration

| Spec | Direct dependencies | Full prerequisite chain | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| registration/01_apo_registration_spec.rb | — | — | — |
| registration/02_register_objects_spec.rb | `apo_creation` | registration/01_apo_registration_spec.rb | — |

### accessioning

| Spec | Direct dependencies | Full prerequisite chain | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| accessioning/image_accessioning_spec.rb | `image_accessioning` | registration/01_apo_registration_spec.rb → registration/02_register_objects_spec.rb | — |
| accessioning/virtual_object_spec.rb | `constituent_*` | registration/01_apo_registration_spec.rb → registration/02_register_objects_spec.rb | — |

### sdr

| Spec | Direct dependencies | Full prerequisite chain | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| sdr/standalone_spec.rb | — | — | — |

### verify

| Spec | Direct dependencies | Full prerequisite chain | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| verify/image_review_spec.rb (`if: Settings.review.enabled`) | `image_accessioning`<br>`never_saved`<br>state: accessioning/image_accessioning_spec.rb | registration/01_apo_registration_spec.rb → registration/02_register_objects_spec.rb → accessioning/image_accessioning_spec.rb | not replayable: needs a freshly accessioned object |

### untyped

| Spec | Direct dependencies | Full prerequisite chain | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| untyped_spec.rb | — | — | — |

## Keys written but never read

No spec other than the writer loads these.

- `goobi_accessioning`, written by registration/02_register_objects_spec.rb (`if: $sdr_env == 'stage'`)
- `standalone`, written by sdr/standalone_spec.rb

## Keys loaded but never written

These specs will fail in `load_test_data` whatever runs first.

- `never_saved`, loaded by verify/image_review_spec.rb

## Analysis warnings

- spec/features/untyped_spec.rb: no `type:` metadata, so the global ordering will not run it

## Caveat

`load_test_data` uses today's data file if there is one. Otherwise it falls back to the most recent
`tmp/*_data.yml`. A spec run on its own can therefore pick up stale druids from an earlier day,
and you won't get an error about it.
